// diagnostic

E0961

A member-spread list entry is not a bare name.

What

A member-spread list entry is not a bare name.

Why

`prefix.[a, b]` only expands field or package names off the prefix — calls and expressions are not members.

Fix

Write bare names like `default.[cargo, ripgrep]`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0961: tests/ui/member_spread_not_ident.stderr.

Error [E0320]: inferred record construction uses `{…}`, not `.{…}`
  --> tests/ui/member_spread_not_ident.jet:2:19
    |
  2 |     validators :: .{ length: 1, charset: 2, entropy: 3 }
    |                   ^
 Why: D-LIT-DOT1 drops the constructor dot from every literal head
 Fix: write `{…}`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0320

Error [E0961]: `.[ ]` lists member names, not calls or expressions
  --> tests/ui/member_spread_not_ident.jet:4:39
    |
  4 |     bad :: validators.[length, charset()]
    |                                       ^
 Why: member spread names fields or package names that hang off the prefix
 Fix: write bare names like `default.[cargo, ripgrep]`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0961
